headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 24, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Mitch Keller earning the win. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Pirates' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs. In other news, the Detroit Tigers took down the Baltimore Orioles 4-1, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense and Drew Anderson earning a save.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Erik Sabrowski of the Cleveland Guardians, who was placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 22 due to left elbow inflammation. Other players on the injured list include Cole Winn of the Texas Rangers, Jake Irvin of the Washington Nationals, Edward Cabrera of the Chicago Cubs, Jonny DeLuca of the Tampa Bay Rays, Brant Hurter of the Detroit Tigers, and Lourdes Gurriel Jr. of the Arizona Diamondbacks.

The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for Future Considerations. International Bonus Pool Money. The Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley. The Tampa Bay Rays traded LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn. The Toronto Blue Jays traded LHP Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Blue Jays 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Mitch Keller earning the win. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Pirates' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Fall to Orioles in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 3-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Colton Cowser leading the Orioles' offense. Cowser hit a crucial home run, scoring two runs and driving in three.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Orioles 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense and Drew Anderson earning a save.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Red Sox in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins edged out the Boston Red Sox 6-5, securing their win. Willson Contreras led the Twins' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 2 runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Cubs in Thrilling 1-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a narrow win over the Chicago Cubs, with a final score of 2-1. Ben Brown was a standout performer for the Pirates, leading the team to victory.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins dropped a 1-3 decision to the Chicago White Sox, with Brooks Lee and Alex Jackson contributing for the Twins. Zebby Matthews stood out on the mound for the White Sox.

top_news.title: **Guardians Place Erik Sabrowski on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Cleveland Guardians left-handed pitcher Erik Sabrowski has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation, effective retroactive to May 22, 2026.

top_news.title: **Phillies Make Roster Move Ahead of Sunday's Game**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies have traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies in exchange for Future Considerations and International Bonus Pool Money.
